title: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The War to End All Wars 2

sense.text:
This is part two of The War to End All Wars, and it opens here. “One woe is past”: the woe John the Revelator was referring to is a war. He was shown in a vision that this war would take place in the last days, and that war is passed. This is describing World War One.

“And, behold, there come two woes more hereafter”: there come two more woes, two more wars, afterwards. World War One has taken place; Revelation 9 took place.

precepts.why:
“The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.” The second woe is World War II. Of the three woes spoken of earlier, two have passed, and the Third Woe cometh quickly.

World War II was a very pivotal time in history, because that was the time they discovered how to split atoms: the theory of relativity, Einstein, Oppenheimer. That is how nuclear weapons were created, and eventually the hydrogen bomb; nuclear fission and nuclear science were born.

Now we are in a period where all the major superpowers, the kingdoms, possess nuclear capabilities. Once a nation possesses a certain amount of nuclear capability it becomes a superpower: China, Russia, America. Other nations have them, but those three are the mega ones, the kingdoms around this earth, with America the top one and Russia its rival. It’s the same people. Russia and America is a sibling rivalry, that’s all it really is; both of them is Edom, no different from the Greeks and Romans. Same people. So far two woes have passed, and the third is coming.

sense.text:
This shows that the powers in the heavens understand that two woes have passed already, and they are holding back the third.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth”: an angel for each corner, “holding the four winds of the earth”. They are holding back four winds. You may ask, the wind blows every day, so how are they holding back these winds? Because these are not normal winds: “that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.” The wind blows on the sea, it blows in a tree, it blows on the earth, so this is something else.

The four winds are the armies of the four corners of the earth and their nuclear capability, and the angels on them are holding back that nuclear destruction, that third world war. As the nations keep testing their weapons, the angels are holding it back, disabling the weapons. They are doing nothing until God says so. Wherever there is nuclear capability, China, Russia, America, Iran, the chariots are saying no, not yet; someone turns the lights out on those nukes, and that is the Lord doing it.

The disabling started after America dropped two nukes on Japan. The second woe had to happen, so they let that go ahead and let the second war take place; after that they started disabling them, because it’s not time yet. The third woe is coming, but not now. After World War II they started to stop and interrupt nuclear testing, and wherever the nukes are, bases underwater, Antarctica, hidden places, they are there; they can’t hide nothing.

They are always watching America. They are a threat, just not to us: to them. If Christ didn’t intervene, they would go and destroy this earth with their nuclear weapons. Esau will not do what he wants to do; Esau will do what God allows him to do. Regular missiles you can shoot, but the ICBMs, the missiles that go into space and from one land to the other, not yet. You’re not beating God. It’s not happening, ever.
“To whom it was given to hurt the earth”: this wind is a wind of destruction. It’s war.

“Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees”: the angels on the four corners are told to hold those winds back so they do not hurt the earth, “till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” What is stopping a world war is that the rest of Israel must be sealed first, the remnant of Israel gathered from the four corners, which is very, very few at this time.

precepts.why: You might say, you’re making that up, how do you know the winds refer to destroying winds? “Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon”: this Babylon is the Babylon of today. “And against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind”. That destroying wind is the one the angels are holding back in the four corners.

This proves which Babylon it is. “Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth”: he calls Babylon a destroying mountain, and this Babylon is known to destroy the earth, the sea, the air, people, crops. “And I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks”: this mountain will be rolled down and taken out of power. “And will make thee a burnt mountain.”

Ancient Babylon was never burned. It was taken over, from one landlord to the other, from Babylon to the Persians; it was conquered from the inside and the Persians took over.

“And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.” Saddam Hussein’s backyard was Babylon; he looked out his window and had Babylon right there, and people lived there. That is Iraq, so this is not ancient Babylon. The modern Babylon will be burnt and rolled down from power, and that is the United States of America, the land of the north. The winds are holding back the destruction regarding that land as well, among others.

“And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven”. These are armies that possess nuclear capabilities: the destroying winds refer to armies, destruction, north, south, east and west.

This is the aftermath of World War III, while the nations are in the midst of it: they are gathered “to subdue the man that came out of the sea”. That is when Christ returns. When he rolls up, they are going to stop fighting each other and say, let’s fight this big negro flying in the sky in front of us. The real Superman shows up, not Kal-El: Jesus the Messiah.

sense.text:
A lot of brothers and sisters might be new, and Christians and federal agents are watching too, so the scripture shows what those discs are. “Behold a flying roll”: Zechariah saw a flying roll. Today it is called UFOs, or UAPs.

The FBI has a document, once banned and now opened to the public on the FBI website, whose topic at the top of the paper is a flying roll. Planes that come near it disintegrate; trying to attack it, they get destroyed just coming near it.
“I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.”

“This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth”: the so-called unidentified flying objects are a curse God sends over the whole earth. “For every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it”: that is written on it. It is a curse going forth for Esau, for him to understand that his end is coming soon. How did he get this land, America? He stole it. How did he get Europe? He stole it. Every land this man inherited, he stole.

“And every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.” Esau swears: he calls himself a Jew, and he says In God we trust, but he legalized homosexuality. He is going to be cut off.

“I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts”: he will bring the flying roll forth, and it is a chariot. “And it shall enter into the house of the thief”: the man that steals lands and nationalities and people and resources and everything else. “And into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”: I’m a Jew, I’m a Christian, swearing on the Bible in the courthouse, swearing the president in on the Bible, and not using the Bible.

“And it shall remain in the midst of his house”: that is why they are always watching America. Most of the sightings of the chariots, of all those UAPs, are here; of all lands, this is the place of the thief.

“And shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof”: consume means destroy. That is why they made movies like Independence Day, Battle Los Angeles, War of the Worlds and The Day the Earth Stood Still: Esau’s renditions of him defeating this chariot, which will never happen, and he knows it. In one of those movies, when they ask what they can do to establish peace, the answer is: die. That’s the correct answer.

People say those are aliens. They’re not aliens; they’re aliens to you, not to us. We know what they are from the Bible. Ask the black Christians’ pastors what those things in the sky are, and they don’t got no answers for you. The Israelites got the answers, because the Bible explains all things. A man on the news said these UAPs have been around since biblical times, so they know what they are; they just play dumb, and they watch our videos to see how much we know.

“Their appearance was like burning coals of fire”: that’s how black they were. A man who saw them was asked if they were brown, and he said no, black, and judging by the doorway of the vehicle they were about seven feet tall. Imagine a white man going to the moon, who beat us and set dogs on us and held us down in the street with nightsticks, and seeing black men with no helmets standing there watching him in his helmet, seven feet and beyond, with wings. That’s why the astronauts were told not to say nothing about what they saw.

After the moon landing, Ronald Reagan started the Star Wars program, to defend the earth from outside forces and invasions, because he saw the report: we saw black people in space, we saw angels. That’s why he was so hard on black people. They understand the prophecies: if we are oppressing them here, and there are people up there looking like them, then when they come here they are coming to save us. If they are beating and killing those who look like them up there, they have a problem. They know the Messiah is black and coming to save us. It’s that simple.

“And like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures”: they had a glow all around them, the power going up and down their bodies. “And the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning”: they had lightning all over. That is where the nations get it from; they have no creativity, their creativity comes from the Bible.
“And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning”: that is how fast they move, in one instant over here and over there, faster than Usain Bolt.
“Behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces”: they have a face on each side: a black face here, an animal face here, and here, and in the back.

“The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl”: the wheels, the chariots, are green. “A wheel in the middle of a wheel”: what the witnesses told us was hovering over them was a wheel within a wheel. That is a chariot.
“They turned not when they went”: when they move they don’t have to turn, because they have a face on each side. They just move from side to side, back and forth, left and right.
“As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful”: those chariots above them. “And their rings were full of eyes round about them four”: you call those windows.

“When the living creatures went, the wheels went by them”: when the angels move, the wheels move. You think the chariots are moving by themselves, but you don’t see what is under it or in it; the angel is there moving with it, because it is part of it. “When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up”: when the chariot moves up, there is an angel moving it, outside of it or inside of it. That is their cars, their vehicles. In slavery we sang on the plantation, Swing low, sweet chariot, coming forth to carry me home, because we knew what they were.

“For the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels”: the spirit, the power of the angels, is the power of the vehicle, the power of the chariots. That is why they move so fast. Now you know what the flying roll, the wheel in the middle of a wheel, is.

The point is that the four winds are the angels holding back the nuclear destruction, the third world war; the armies are the four armies of the earth with their nuclear capability.

Part one of The War to End All Wars went into the northern army, and how we will be in danger on this side of the world, and how the Lord is going to bring about an occurrence that removes that army from us. Joel 2 is where that is shown.

“Therefore also now, saith the Lord, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning”. Here he explains why we have to fast and pray for what is coming.

“And rend your heart, and not your garments”. It means change your mind, not rip your clothes because you are sad. Rend your mind. “And turn unto the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.”
“Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly”. A solemn assembly means come together.

“Gather the people”: that goes back to gathering, establishing schools and sanctuaries for this time of evil that is coming. “Sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts”: babies, infants, newborns. “Let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet”: the young people.

“Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar”: sending up our prayers. “And let them say, Spare thy people”. Why? Because on this side of the world, where the army is, we are going to undergo heavy afflictions, the time of sorrows Christ spoke about in Matthew 24. We have always undergone heavy affliction, from Rome to Spain to Greece, and it will happen again. That is why the classes keep teaching preparation for food shortages and the like. It is going to get rough out here.

“Give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?” Prove to the nations that we have a God, rather than have them mock us, saying ‘Where is your God now?’ when they come against us.

“Then will the Lord be jealous for his land”. That is the part to focus on. He is jealous for his land because there are people living in that land that do not belong there. “And pity his people”: his people who belong in that land. So he is going to cause problems to stir revolving around that land.

“Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith”. In the midst of this affliction he will bless us, take care of us and look after us. “And I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen”: our deliverance will start taking place in the midst of that affliction.

“But I will remove far off from you the northern army”. The northern army is on this side of the world. “And will drive him into a land barren and desolate”, because there is going to be war in that land, the land he is jealous over. “With his face toward the east sea”: the army is going to leave the north and leave us alone, its attention drawn toward the east. The east sea is the Dead Sea, the land of Israel. He will bring conflict over there and take their attention off of us on this side and turn it to the east, the near East we call the Middle East today. That is why we pray ‘spare thy people’: our people are going to be hurt, killed and imprisoned in that time while the army is on this side, but the Lord will bring about an interruption and take them away from us to focus on the conflict in the east. That is also why the Lord said to gather together: in that time we are going to need each other more than ever, and when it starts to affect us and we pray to the Lord and come together, he brings that interruption.

“And his hinder part toward the utmost sea”: the utmost sea is the Mediterranean, which borders Israel. On the map, the Mediterranean is the utmost sea, and by the West Bank and Gaza Strip is the Dead Sea. The army will be brought over there, and the conflict will make the land barren and desolate, not all of it but a portion.

“And his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up”: they are going to go to battle over there and be destroyed. “Because he hath done great things”: terrible things, to us over here. They are going to pay over there for their evils toward us here.

It is heavy: the Lord says he will remove the northern army far from us. That proves where Israel is going to be and where the affliction is going to be really bad: right here in America, here in Babylon, the land of the north. It will happen across the world, but not on the level it will here. It will be so bad that the Lord will cause something to happen in the land of Israel, with those fake Jews over there, to remove the northern army that is afflicting us here. So prepare for what is coming, and build your faith up, because at that time the chosen are going to stand up.

precepts.why:
Zephaniah 2 has a twofold meaning; there are classes that read it with Joel 2 about the Lord showing up, parallel with Revelation. In this instance it is referring to this side of the world, the same as Joel 2.

“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”, “before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.” That is the affliction, the same thing as the northern army.

“Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness”. How do you do that? By coming together, under the same mind and the same body. That is the gathering together of Joel 2:16. “It may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” The Lord’s anger is when he sends the nations against us, and also the eventual destruction of this place.

There is going to be a conflict because the Lord is jealous over the land. Why is he jealous? Because there are nations that live there that should not be there, that claim it is their land, that God gave it to them in 1948.

“Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. Mount Seir is Edom.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity”. In the time Babylon came against us, Edom joined forces with them and began to kill us, enslave us and take parts of our land while we were in exile. “In the time that their iniquity had an end”: they furthered it.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”. They cannot escape that curse that follows behind them; they are prepared for slaughter no matter what they do or say. “Sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee”: you do not hate killing, so you are going to be killed. Live by the sword, die by the sword.

“I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. There will be no more Washington, no more New York, no more Detroit, no more Cali, no more France, no more Italy. It is over: their cities will be destroyed along with them.

“Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine”. The two nations are the southern and northern kingdom. On this side of the world they took us as slaves and took our land as theirs: Manifest Destiny, this belongs to us. Manifest Destiny is one, and the declaration is the other. “And we will possess it”: the lands on this side of the world and on the other side of the world. “Whereas the Lord was there”, because God’s people were there.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will even do according to thine anger”. They mutilated us in Israel and, in the time of Rome, killed us; on this side of the world entire empires were erased from existence, the Inca, the Aztec, the Maya, the North American Indians. So the Lord will do with them according to their anger. “And according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them”. Why the envy? Because God did not choose them. Even though they are the older brother, that hatred against Jacob was there back then: they said when Isaac dies, I’m going to kill Jacob. That hatred passed down through the lineage, through the loins.

Brothers and sisters ask why white people don’t love us, why we can’t get along with them, why wherever you go in true history they keep afflicting us and enslaving us. It is the natural hatred and envy they have toward us. Even in the war in Ukraine, with Russia attacking Ukraine, they treat us like garbage and push us back in the line; even in the midst of war with their own people they are still mad at us.

“Against them”: against us. “And I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee”, which he is doing now. “And thou shalt know that I am the Lord, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel”. What blasphemies? ‘We’re the Jews, we’re the Christians, and you’re the Gentiles, you’re the Hamites, you’re the curse of Ham.’ That is what they say. “Saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume. Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me”, against God, “I have heard them.” He heard them, and he has something for them.

The next chapter carries it on. “Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel”. “Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession”: we have Iraq, we have Iran, we have Syria, we have Israel, we have America, these places belong to us; and the Palestinians say part of that land is theirs too. They say aha, the ancient places are ours.

“Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people”. We are the most infamous people no matter where we go: coons, criminals, hoods and thugs, gangsters. We sit down somewhere and they get up and move. We as a nation live in infamy among the nations: in Ukraine, China, America, South Africa, Ethiopia, Iraq, Iran, Mauritania.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen”: the nations, especially the Palestinians. “And against all Idumea”: all Edom, whatever they call themselves today, Russian, German, Greek, Spanish, Polish, Danish, Dutch, all of them are Idumea. “Which have appointed my land into their possession”: he is referring to those who took his land into their possession, the Amalekite Israelis. “With the joy of all their heart”, by stealing it, “with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey”: a tourist attraction, come visit Israel, come see the wailing wall. Liars.

That is the Idumeans who took our land. The Lord is jealous for that land, as Joel says, and will bring about conflict over that land, and that conflict over the land will initiate the war, the third woe.

“For it is the day of the Lord’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.” The controversy of Zion is the people as well as the land.

That is heavy when you look around the world right now. Go to the land of Israel: there is conflict, there is fighting, there is a big controversy over who that land belongs to. Does it belong to the Palestinians, or to the people the United Nations put in that land and said it belongs to them?

“A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the Lord hath a controversy with the nations”. The Lord has beef with the nations. “He will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.” He is going to bring these nations to destruction, and it will revolve around the controversy of that land.

“And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people”. He will make that land a burdensome stone for all people. “All that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces”: all that claim the land to be theirs. That is the Israelis and the Palestinians; and America too will be cut in pieces, because America funded the Israelis to maintain that land as their own. Russia as well, because Russia helps Iran, which is in league with Palestine. All nations involved with or connected to that land’s inhabitants will be judged: Palestinians, Israelis, America, Syrians, all of them are going to face judgment. “Though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.”

sense.text:
Isaiah 14 is often read about the fall of Babylon, not ancient Babylon but the fall of modern Babylon. Here is something new from it.

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand”. What happens will happen because he says it will happen.

“That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.” This is twofold, but it is referring to modern day Assyrians. So who is the Assyrian in this land, and who are the ones whose burden shall depart off their shoulders?

In the time of Isaiah the Assyrians had conquered part of the land, the northern kingdom of Israel, and were strangers in that land. So when Isaiah calls them Assyrians, he is talking about strangers, other nations living in the land of Israel that do not belong there. The Assyrian in this context is Edom, the strangers in the land today.

Isaiah 14 says God will break the Assyrian in his land, so the question is who that Assyrian is, and Micah 5 answers it. Normally Micah 5 is read at verses 1 and 2 and stopped there, because that is the prophecy of the Messiah, his tribe, and him being our King. Tonight it is read further down.

“That is to be ruler in Israel”: out of Judah shall come forth the king of Israel, the ruler. This is Christ. “Whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting” is speaking of the Lord.

“Therefore will he give them up”: he will put us in captivity. “Then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel”: Israel is going to come back together and be reunited again. The twelve tribes will come together, repent, acknowledge that they are Israel, and come back together. That is happening now.

“And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord”: he is the one spoken of in verse 2, the Messiah, standing “in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God.” “And they shall abide”: Israel shall abide. “For now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth”: Christ, that same ruler of verse 2, shall be great unto the ends of the earth.

“And this man shall be the peace”: so you know it is Christ. This man that comes out of Judah shall be the peace between the Southern and Northern Kingdom, restoring the twelve tribes back together again. He will be that peace when he comes to the earth.

“When the Assyrian shall come into our land”: when Christ walked the earth, were the Assyrians in the land? No, they were not. They were conquered and overthrown by the Babylonians hundreds of years before. So the Assyrian here is not the ancient Assyrian. Then who is this Assyrian treading in the land?

“Then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men”: raised up to prophesy against him while he is living in our land.

The Benson commentary read in the class bears it out: the actual event of the Assyrians attacking Israel back then does not correspond to this. It is prophecy, using those names and that nation, but not speaking of that time. The seven shepherds and eight principal men are men the Lord is going to raise up to pray and prophesy against the Assyrian, the way Hezekiah and his men prayed against the Assyrians when they came against Jerusalem. So we are going to pray and prophesy against Edom when they come against us.

The same commentary says “this man shall be the peace” is Christ: our peace as a priest, making atonement for sin, and our peace as a king, conquering our enemies and protecting us against their attacks. And after the prophecy of the Messiah, the prophet passes on to the overthrow of the Assyrian, using that ancient enemy of God’s people as a type of their enemies in the latter days, the powers that would attack his people in the latter days, which would be America. So even the commentators know Micah 5 is a future prophecy. It is not ancient Assyria. It is another Assyria; it is prophetic.

“And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof”: the land of Nimrod was called Babylon. So the land of Assyria and the land of Nimrod are put together.

“Thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.” What nation has tread into our borders and is in our land? We read it earlier: Edom. That is who the Assyrian is. In ancient times the Assyrians took possession of Israel and of the land, and Edom has done the same thing. Edom took it over as Rome first, and took it over again.

precepts.why:
“Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” It is the children of Edom.

“O daughter of Babylon”: what is Edom called? The daughter of Babylon, or the Assyrian. It is the same land mass, the land of Assyria and the land of Nimrod; it is the same people. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” “Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.” Oh happy day: smash the kids against the stone.

So Edom is the daughter of Babylon, or the Assyrians; they represent that. What were the Assyrians known for? Taking Israel off their land, putting them in foreign lands, and putting heathen nations there in their place. That was the Assyrians’ policy, and those are the Babylonian attributes. That is what Edom has done today: put us somewhere else and put themselves there. So God refers to them as the Assyrians in Micah and in Isaiah 14.

In the time of Isaiah the Assyrians had conquered part of the land, the northern kingdom of Israel, and they were strangers living in that land. So when Isaiah 14 speaks of the Assyrian, it is talking about strangers, other nations living in the land of Israel that do not belong there.

“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: the Israelites fell by the edge of the sword. “And shall be led away captive into all nations”: we were led away as slaves into all nations. “And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”: Gentiles is another term for the Assyrians.

“Until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.” Have the times of the Gentiles been fulfilled? No. They are fulfilled when Christ returns, establishes God’s kingdom on earth, and puts the true Israelites back in that land.

So if the times of the Gentiles are not fulfilled, who are the people living in that land right now? They are Gentiles. They are strangers. That is why Isaiah called them Assyrians: the land of Assyria is a name for Israel because of the strangers living there in the land who do not belong there.

sense.text:
Keep in mind that the land of Assyria is Israel with strangers living in it.

“Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun.” Why is Japan called the Land of the Rising Sun? Because it is the Far East, where the sun rises. The rising of the sun is speaking of the Far East: China, North Korea, South Korea, Japan. North Korea, right above South Korea and next door to Japan, has nuclear capabilities.

“From the south, from the east”: the so-called Middle or Near East, India, Israel, Syria, Iraq, Iran, that area, and Lebanon.

“To turn themselves one against another”: God is going to turn them one against another. “And repay the things that they have done to them”: the them is us. We are the them. All those nations listed here, from all parts of the world, all had a hand in the enslavement of our people.

“Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen.” A perfect example: when the virus dropped, our brothers from this side of the world, African Americans, and West Africans living in the Guangzhou Province of China, were evicted from their homes. They were blamed for causing the covid over there, when it started in their own land, and they ended up living in the street in Guangzhou. That is the same province where they had our people as slaves in times past; they called us black devils. The dynasties, the Ming among them, treated us like garbage. So these nations have a lot to pay for.

Prophecy is being fulfilled. Europe is building an army.

Read again: the east wind and the west wind are going to be destroyed. Destroyed by who? By the ten horns, by Europe, the European Union. The great and mighty cloud is the ten horns.

precepts.why:
“Behold, a people shall come from the north”: this people coming from the north is Europe, because Europe is north of where Israel is. “And a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth”: many kings, because it’s the ten horns, but today it’s over 27 nations that came together.

“They shall hold the bow and the lance”: weapons of war. “They are cruel, and will not shew mercy”. “Their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.” Against who? The daughter of Babylon. So this is the ten horns going to fight against America, because the daughter of Babylon is America.

Read early on, but to refresh your memory on who the daughter of Babylon is. This is what we read in 2 Esdras and what we’re about to read in Revelation: these kings that are going to rise up are the ten common markets of Revelation 17.

It’s not talking about ancient Babylon; it’s talking about the daughter of Babylon, which is America. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. So Edom is the daughter of Babylon.

sense.text:
This is 2 Esdras 15:40 again: the ten horns that are going to destroy America, and not just America, they’re going to destroy the Chinese army also. That’s Europe.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet”: when John wrote that, they didn’t have no kingdom as yet; the European Union wasn’t set up as yet. “But receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: they’re set up as kings, as rulers, one hour with America, the beast.

“These have one mind”: don’t you see what’s going on in Europe? All the 27 countries have one mind. It was ten countries when it started; right now it’s over 27 countries.

“And shall give their power and strength unto the beast”: after World War II they all gave their power and strength to America. They formed the NATO alliance, and America was the head ruling them. But right now they are taking that power and strength away from America. That’s what’s going on right now. That’s why Britain left the European Union: Brexit.

“These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings”. Who is going to make war with the Lamb? The European nations, them ten horns: they’re going to make war with Christ. Why didn’t it say America is going to make war with Christ? Because of what is going to happen to America.
“The waters which thou sawest” “are peoples, and multitudes, and nations”. The one sitting on those waters is talking about America. Yes, America: she’s nasty and dirty.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate”: these ten horns are what we just read in Jeremiah 50:41. These ten kings are going to rise up and destroy the daughter of Babylon. They’re going to hate America: in the future the European Union is going to turn against America and hate her. “And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire”: they’re going to destroy America with fire.

The ten horns are going to burn America with fire, and all of it takes place in World War III, over the controversy of Zion, in the valley of Jehoshaphat, the valley of decision, because of what they did to God’s people.

“The great and mighty clouds” are the ten common markets, the European nations. They are going to be lifted up full of wrath: America is going to do something to get them mad, China is going to do something to get them mad. They “make all the earth afraid” with that star they rise up with, and that star is going into nuclear weapons, missiles.

“they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star”: every famous, important, vital city. A horrible star is a bomb. Washington D.C., New York, all these places, and even certain places over in the Middle East. This is what the ten horns are going to do.

“Fire, and hail, and flying swords”: that is what we keep showing you. When these missiles shoot out, they look like flying swords. “And many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters”: they are going to be dropping bombs even in the waters. Imagine that nuclear bomb, a couple of them, dropped in the sea water. A lot of the islands are going to disappear. Some of you think you are going back to the islands to hide from World War III; you are going to be buried under water. You need the angels to deliver you when those big waves come.
“They shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.” Mountains and hills are going to be broken down.

“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon”: Babylon is America. After they do all this, they go steadfastly unto America, the same thing we read in Revelation 17. This lets you know who the great and mighty clouds are: the ten horns, the European nations. “And make her afraid”: they will make America afraid, because they already destroyed America’s armies over in the Middle East.

“They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her”: all wrath poured out upon America. This is the judgment that is going to take place here in America, the same judgment you read in the whole chapter of Revelation 18. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven”: they are going to pour those bombs, nuclear weapons, out on America, and the dust and smoke go up from Babylon. “And all they that be about her shall bewail her”: they will bewail America.

So all you white people that got bomb shelters, you are doing the right thing. But when they pour those bombs on America, the Messiah is coming here to America, and Christ said look up, because in the midst of that destruction is where we are going to be delivered. The Lord shows us step by step what is going to take place: the European nations are going to turn on America and destroy her, and the war starts in the Middle East over who that land belongs to, the controversy of Zion. That is what is going to cause World War III.

This is World War III: America being destroyed by the ten horns.

“And they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear.” They that remain under America are the nations America has alliance with, probably like Japan and other nations. They are going to do service unto the European nations and humble down to the ten horns.

precepts.why:
Read this to see why people are going to be dying of thirst. Some of you think you can live by the stream and get water to drink; here is what is going to happen. “And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven”: that great star is the same star we read about in 2 Esdras 15, the horrible star poured out over every eminent place.

“Burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters”: the same thing we just read in 2 Esdras, the star poured out on every eminent city and on the waters and the rivers.

“And the name of the star is called Wormwood”: that is the nuclear bomb. “And the third part of the waters became wormwood”, meaning it became bitter, poisonous, “and many men died of the waters.” That many people die from drinking that water. This is what is going to take place in the World War III that is coming. The prophets saw it, recorded it, and left it for us to understand.

The same thing as the dust and smoke going up and all bewailing her in 2 Esdras 15:44. “And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.” In one hour she is going to be destroyed, and this is talking about America.

“Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.” God has avenged the Israelites.

“And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.” It is done.

“And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth”: that is the great war that is taking place, the great earthquake. That war is going to start in the valley of Jehoshaphat, in the Middle East, in that land over there.

“And the great city was divided into three parts”: when those bombs drop, America is going to be divided into three parts. It is not going to be one land mass anymore. “And the cities of the nations fell”: a lot of the cities of the other nations are going to fall. “And great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.”

“And every island fled away”: Jamaica is going to disappear, Haiti, Antigua, Puerto Rico are going to disappear. There are no islands left anymore. Why? Go back to 2 Esdras 15:41, “fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full”: they are going to be dropping bombs in the waters, that is the wormwood, and the islands go under.

sense.text:
Now China’s destiny, how China is going to be destroyed. The Asia here is mainly talking about China. There are many Asian countries, but the main one is China, because every good you have here in America is made in China.

“And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon”: Asia has been partaking in the hope of Babylon, getting rich off trading with America the most. “And art the glory of her person.”

“Woe be unto thee, thou wretch, because thou hast made thyself like unto her”: China made herself just like America. America goes over to Africa buying up and taking over the land and the resources from the people, and China goes over there doing the same thing.

“And hast decked thy daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in thy lovers”: the Chinese are hoes too. You a hoe too, China, and you are going to be dealt with. Her daughters are going into all the corporations that are set up all over the world for trading.

“Which have always desired to commit whoredom with thee”: China has committed fornication, whoredom, with America. All nations did it, but China is one of the top nations involved in the whoredom America is doing.

“Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions”: God hates America, and China followed America, which is hated by God, in all her works. The technology, everything America invented, China invents it too; the architecture, how the buildings and skyscrapers are built; the same sex stuff; China copies all of it.
“Therefore saith God, I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence”: the plagues God sends on China for following America.

precepts.why:
This is where 2 Esdras 15:47 goes back to: China has committed fornication and whoredom with America. “For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”: the kings of the earth, China among them, committed fornication with her.

“And the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies”: the merchants of the earth is mainly talking about China. They are the number one merchant that trades with America. Everything you got on is made in China.

sense.text: “They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger”: this is talking about China, because at this time China has no military; the military was destroyed. “And eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.” That is what is going to happen in China; they will be suffering over there when World War III is taking place.

“Thou as unhappy shalt come through the sea”: this is talking about the U.S. Navy, and it lets you know how China is going to be destroyed. America is going to go over to China with their naval ships and their submarines and destroy the cities in China. “And receive plagues again”: America is going to be unhappy because her military will be destroyed.

Even though America’s military is destroyed, the government is not going to be destroyed. The U.S. military and the U.S. government have underground shelters where they could live for twenty years in case of a nuclear fallout. From those underground bunkers set up all over America they will command the parts of the military that were not destroyed, and tell the Navy: go destroy China.

“And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city”: the idle cities are the cities in China, Beijing, Hong Kong, the one with the coronavirus. “And shall destroy some portion of thy land”: they are going to destroy some portion of the land of China. “And consume part of thy glory”: they consume part of China’s glory.

“And shall return to Babylon that was destroyed”: this lets you know who does it, the American Navy. They go back to America, whose soil was destroyed with nuclear bombs, but they will probably be offshore just watching.

precepts.why:
To show that 2 Esdras 15:59-60 is talking about the U.S. Navy. “For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle”: he that shall fly as an eagle is America, because the eagle is his symbol.

Read two verses up to see what this is going into. “There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof”: Moab being destroyed, people sad, crying, bawling. “For I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.” How is God going to break Moab? He is going to use the United States Navy to go over there and drop nuclear bombs on certain cities in Moab. “How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.”

Verse 40 tells you how Moab is going to get destroyed: he “shall spread his wings over Moab.” That is what we read in 2 Esdras: it lets you know who is going to destroy, the American Navy.

sense.text:
Remember the name of the class: the war to end all wars. We showed you what is going to happen to America, what is going to happen to China, and what will start that war, the controversy over Zion. This is the aftermath.

“For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy”: some die from hunger and some from the sword, meaning from the war that is going to take place.

“And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them”: there will be no man left to bury the dead. “For the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down”: a lot of the cities and a lot of places on the earth are going to be destroyed through the wars of World War III. Not every place, but a lot of the cities and places.

“There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it”: nobody left to cut grass and farm. “The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?” The fruits will grow on the tree and just drop on the ground, because nobody will be there to gather them.

“For all places shall be desolate of men: so that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.” One man is going to be like, damn, I ain’t seen nobody in a year, in months. He will desire to see somebody else and just hear somebody speak.

“For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field”: only ten left of a city, only two in the field. “Which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks”: this is how they will escape that destruction, hiding in the forest, in the rocks, in the mountains and underground.

“As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives”, and “Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.” People will be running up in your house to steal your food if you got food. It is going to be the Walking Dead, the Book of Eli.

“And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old”: like when you watch I Am Legend and see the cities grown up with grass. That is after the war, after those bombs drop and time goes by. “And her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns”: all the roads overgrown with thorns, “because no man shall travel therethrough”, because there is nobody to travel there. This is a picture of what the future is going to look like.

And y’all stay on TikTok twerking, sisters out there twerking, brothers out there stunting, about what kind of dumb stuff. The world is about to come to an end. Even the little war going on in Ukraine right now is preparing and putting certain things in place: it affects the food supply and the oil supply. They put sanctions on Russia, but the sanctions affect America even more, with gas rising up to ten dollars. The only thing that makes the American dollar valuable today is that it is used to trade to buy oil; remove the oil from it, the nations stop using it, and the dollar is going to collapse. That is why an executive order was signed this week for America to come up with a digital cryptocurrency. Pay attention: the American dollar is not going to be worth nothing.

“The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms”: there are going to be no brothers around for them to marry in that time. You single sisters think you are mourning right now; the scripture says the virgins shall mourn. This is talking about the nations, not Israel, not those of us that are saved.

“The women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers. In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed”: in World War III their bridegrooms are going to be destroyed, “and their husbands shall perish of famine.”

“Hear now these things, and understand them, ye servants of the Lord”: this is talking to you, brothers and sisters, you servants of the Lord, you Israelites. Hear these things and understand them; it is going to come to pass. “Behold the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.” Hear the word of the Lord and believe it.

“Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.” Whether you believe it or not, it is not going to stop what is going to take place. You could get mad and leave IUIC; it is not going to stop what is going to take place. You could say you are doing your own thing and following no man; you could do what the hell you want. Our job is to guide you and to show you what is coming. You want to go do your own thing, be rebellious, not fall in or follow orders: to hell with you, straight up. With the things that are coming on this earth, we ain’t got no time for foolishness.
